title: Leveraging Critical Proof Obligations for Efficient IC3 Verification
problem: IC3 model-checking methods spend significant effort tracking proof obligations (states to prove unreachable), creating a bottleneck in hardware verification performance due to inefficient proof obligation management.
motivation: Hardware verification is a critical verification bottleneck; improving IC3's proof obligation handling directly reduces verification time for complex designs.
method: Introduces Critical Proof Obligations (CPOs) that identify high-impact proof obligations, and applies two techniques: CPO-Driven UNSAT Core Generation to extract minimal sets of constraints, and CPO-Driven Proof Obligation Propagation to accelerate frame refinement and lemma discovery.
key_novelty: First to prioritize proof obligations by criticality and use this signal to guide lemma propagation and frame refinement in IC3.
contributions: Critical Proof Obligations framework to identify high-impact proof states
CPO-Driven Proof Obligation Propagation for faster frame refinement
Significant performance improvements on HWMCC benchmarks

metrics.other: Improved CPO discovery and lemma propagation (specific metrics not reported)

limitations: Specific performance metrics and benchmarks not detailed in abstract; scalability to industrial designs unclear.
